name: Micro-Expression Analysis
description: Detects unnatural micro-expressions and facial action unit patterns in video.
useCase: Identifying deepfakes through abnormal facial muscle movement patterns
mechanism: Analyzes Facial Action Coding System (FACS) action units to detect micro-expressions - brief, involuntary facial movements lasting 40-200ms. Deepfake videos often lack natural micro-expressions, show impossible AU combinations, or exhibit delayed/absent emotional transitions.
source: Agarwal, S. et al. (2020) - Detecting Deep-Fake Videos from Aural and Oral Dynamics, CVPR Workshop
algorithm: AU Detection (OpenFace) + Temporal Pattern Analysis + FACS Plausibility Verification
parameters: AU detection: 17 core AUs, Temporal resolution: 40ms, Window: 200ms sliding, Threshold: AU probability > 0.5
strengths:
• Based on established facial coding system
• Detects subtle involuntary expressions
• Works on both face swap and reenactment
• Leverages decades of psychology research
limitations:
• Requires high frame rate video (>25fps)
• Frontal face orientation preferred
• Cultural differences in expression
• Occluded faces reduce accuracy

references.title: Agarwal, S. et al. (2020). Detecting Deep-Fake Videos from Aural and Oral Dynamics. CVPR Workshop.
Li, Y. & Lyu, S. (2019). Exposing DeepFake Videos By Detecting Face Warping Artifacts. CVPR Workshop.
Amerini, I. et al. (2019). Deepfake Video Detection through Optical Flow Based CNN. ICDP.
